title: Acid
content: An acid is a compound that dissolves in water to produce hydrogen ions, H+.

title: Dissociation reaction
content: A dissociation reaction is a chemical reaction in which a compound breaks apart into two or more parts.

title: Strong acid
content: Strong acid is an acid that completely dissociates in water and gives H+ ions.

title: Weak acid
content: Weak acid is an acid that partially dissociates in aqueous solution and gives H+ ions.

title: Alkali
content: An alkali is a base which is soluble in water producing OH- ions.

title: Indicator
content: An indicator is a substance that has different colours in acidic and alkaline solutions.

title: Neutralisation
content: Neutralisation is the reaction between an acid and a base to form a salt and water only.
